calibration_exposure.status: calibration-visible reduced model-form freeze; execution-heldout outcome firewall remains closed

v6_failure_record.interpretation: a carried recipe-path state improves depth drift, but separate deposition, cleaning, and wall-response rates are structurally confounded

process_domain.validity_rule: refuse application when a production trace has SF6/C4F8 dose ratio outside [5.635257777059961, 5.737394214801463]
process_domain.meaning: v7 identifies only net memory along this fixed recipe path; it does not separately identify deposition and cleaning kinetics

recipe_path_state.name: cumulative normalized C4F8 production exposure since declared conditioning
recipe_path_state.lot_initial_state: H_start=0 exactly after every declared conditioning sequence
recipe_path_state.inter_wafer_transport: H_end from every processed wafer is H_start for the next wafer in the same lot, including traces without measured outcomes
recipe_path_state.inter_wafer_break: H is held constant during recorded one-minute plasma-off breaks
recipe_path_state.lot_boundary: H resets only at a declared conditioning sequence
recipe_path_state.physical_interpretation: identifiable net recipe-path wall load; not a claim of literal fluorocarbon coverage or independently measured deposition/cleaning rates

physical_action.zero_dimensional_neutral_state: divide F and C4F8-film-precursor reference lifetimes by the combined wall-loss multiplier
physical_action.cylindrical_neutral_transfer: multiply upper and sidewall F and film-precursor loss velocities by the combined wall-loss multiplier

free_parameters.b_H_bound_rationale: ten reference-dose production wafers may change the log neutral wall-loss multiplier by at most ln(4)

identifiability_gate.jacobian_unit: four fitted shared coefficients against calibration residual vector
identifiability_gate.bound_contact_rule: b_H within 0.1 percent of a bound fails identification unless a profile-likelihood interval closes inside the bound
identifiability_gate.failure_action: refuse the prediction seal and do not open heldout outcomes

calibration_and_selection.fit_scope: one shared four-coefficient law across calibration lots
calibration_and_selection.heldout_lot_initialization: H=0 after its declared conditioning sequence
calibration_and_selection.objective: the frozen v5 aggregate residual vector with unchanged gates
required_before_heldout_reveal: all unchanged absolute calibration gates pass
aggregate whole-lot leave-one-out physics scores beat the global-mean depth baseline
aggregate whole-lot leave-one-out physics scores beat the shared mean-map point and normalized-shape baselines
the recipe-path model improves signed within-lot depth-slope error over v5
selected parameters are replayed through the exact reactor-to-surface path
certification-grid refinement changes each observable by less than 0.25 of its frozen gate
code, data, parameter, fold-score, and heldout-prediction hashes are sealed

deterministic_acceleration.method: thirteen exact Chebyshev nodes in log wall-loss multiplier with shape-preserving one-dimensional interpolation
deterministic_acceleration.interpolation_validation: the twelve independent midpoints not used to build the interpolant
deterministic_acceleration.final_fit_replay: all scores used for a seal must be recomputed through the exact reactor, cylindrical transfer, and surface path

forbidden_shortcuts: using wafer number, experiment key, lot number, date, or target depth as a model input
independent per-lot, per-wafer, or heldout initial wall states
additive or multiplicative corrections applied directly to predicted depth
claiming separately identified wall deposition and cleaning rates from this fixed-ratio dataset
applying the recipe-path state outside the frozen SF6/C4F8 dose-ratio domain
changing Belen or La Magna/Garozzo surface coefficients
changing positive-ion energy, flux, or radial transfer
using heldout outcomes to choose signs, bounds, nodes, or coefficients
weakening acceptance, baseline, identifiability, replay, or refinement gates
